record.title: Saudi Qatar blockade land component
record.movement: General passengers and freight with separate reopening phases
record.exceptions: Pilgrim access from August 17 2017, followed by reported humanitarian passage before renewed December closure.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current-status inference
record.official_rationale: Saudi Arabia alleged Qatari support for extremist groups and close ties with Iran; Qatar denied the allegations.
record.context: Diplomatic transport embargo with exceptional pilgrimage access; ordinary passenger traffic restarted 9 January 2021, cargo 14 February 2021.
record.uncertainty: June month precision is retained for ordinary passenger onset. Contemporary freight blockage is documented June 5, while a later account gives a different initial gate chronology. January 9 2021 is the passenger restoration endpoint; cargo resumed February 14. Humanitarian and pilgrimage exceptions preclude a total continuous closure claim.
